title: WP-Bot Result Object
description: A result object: what Track B (WordPress site/state service) sends back to Track A (WhatsApp conversation service). The other half of the only coupling point between the two services. Do not change without bumping contract_version and updating both tracks.

contract_version.description: Semantic version of this contract. Both services must send and accept the same value; a mismatch is a hard error (see README).

status.description: success = change applied; failed = could not apply (see error_message); needs_confirmation = Track B needs the owner to confirm before applying (ambiguous request, low confidence, or irreversible change).

change_id.description: Stable id Track B assigns to this change. Track A uses it to refer back to the change in follow-up messages and confirmations.

before.description: Previous state of the content, if any (null for create).

after.description: New state of the content, if any (null for delete).

live_url.description: URL where the change is live on the site, when applicable (null otherwise).

error_message.description: Human-readable error message when status = failed; must be null for success.
